summary: No further submission this turn: 46 seconds of total allocation remain, which is shorter than any construction, execution and interpretation cycle, and the instruction is that expiry preserves existing work without a closing call or empty budget-filling action. The last submitted update (the successor experiment that instruments the demoted peer's log indices so the open gap's branch - delivery stall versus configuration-processing gap - is named by its violated predicate) already executed as CheckRun d68cf5de4c1c4fff8d9eefd82527a86e; its receipt is retained and awaits interpretation, and until then the previously recorded accounts stand unchanged. State at expiry: three settled lines, each with fixed experiments, retained receipts and a current account - VerifyLeader confirmable by a non-voter's acknowledgement for the whole configured lease with the voter-only lease check as the bound (asserted); the demotion-view lag refuted across seven sampled runs and closed; LeadershipTransferToServer to a non-voter reporting success indistinguishable from a real handover while the sitting leadership is interrupted and a fresh election decides (asserted) - plus three promoted facts (one corrected to report the observed latency range), and one open gap owned by the VerifyLeader investigation about the unexplained divergence of the near_node_self_voter field, which no claim depends on.
